title: Layer clean-up: merge misnamed layers, clear overrides to ByLayer, prove it
summary: Move every entity of the misnamed layers onto one standard layer and delete them, set every entity's colour and lineweight back to ByLayer, and prove it with an empty iso128 / layer_color / property_override critique - one cad_batch, never one call per entity.

notes: The target layer must exist before the merge (layer_create it first); a missing source or target, layer 0, DEFPOINTS or the target among the sources is refused by name before anything changes.
layer_merge reassigns model space, every paper layout and every block definition: an edited definition changes every INSERT of that block, and blocks_touched names them.
The ByLayer step touches every entity of every space; run the batch with dry_run=true first to read the counts, and pin them with expect_count when a stale count must refuse.
One target per run: merge onto several standard layers by putting one layer_merge step per target in the same cad_batch.

sources.description: The misnamed layers to merge away.

target.description: The existing standard layer that receives their entities (e.g. GEOMETRY).

steps.purpose: LAYMRG: every entity of the sources moves to the target, then the sources are deleted.
steps.evidence: How many entities moved, per space; the blocks whose definition was edited; the layers deleted.

steps.purpose: Colour and lineweight back to ByLayer on every entity of every space, in one call.
steps.evidence: The matched and modified counts and the changes summary.

steps.purpose: Every entity follows its layer and every layer is ISO 128.
steps.evidence: The issue list; empty is the gate.

steps.purpose: The layer table after the clean-up, for the report.
steps.evidence: One row per layer: name, colour, linetype, lineweight.

postconditions.says: No entity overrides its layer and every layer is ISO 128.
